Precondition: Config Tool open at Plant Hierarchy
Step: Inspect the location-type tiers available in the hierarchy
Expected Result: Five ISA-95 types exist — Enterprise, Site, Area, Work Center, Cell — with ascending hierarchy levels

Precondition: Config Tool open at Plant Hierarchy
Step: Attempt to rename or delete one of the five location types
Expected Result: No edit/delete affordance for the LocationType tiers; they are seed-locked and not editable by engineering

Precondition: An Area with no Work Center tier beneath it
Step: Create a Cell directly under the Area
Expected Result: Cell is accepted as a direct child of the Area — strict sequential tiers are not required, only child level >= parent level

Precondition: An existing Location in the tree
Step: Attempt to change a Location's parent
Expected Result: No reparent control exists; ParentLocationId is immutable — relocation is done by deprecating the row and creating a new one under the new parent, preserving history

Precondition: Config Tool open at Plant Hierarchy
Step: Inspect the Area-tier nodes under the Site
Expected Result: MPP's operational areas exist as Location instances (Die Cast, Trim Shop, Machine Shop, Production Control, Quality Control) with ProductionArea / SupportArea definitions

Precondition: Config Tool open at the Location Type Definition editor
Step: Review the definitions (kinds) available within each tier
Expected Result: Each tier lists its seeded kinds (e.g. Cell -> Terminal, DieCastMachine, CNCMachine, TrimPress, InventoryLocation, Scale); every Location instance references exactly one

Step: Create a new LocationTypeDefinition under a tier and save
Expected Result: New kind is added and available for new Location instances with no schema change; change is audited

Precondition: A Location Type Definition selected in the editor
Step: Define attribute definitions on the kind and compare against another kind at the same tier
Expected Result: Attributes attach per-definition (e.g. DieCastMachine carries Tonnage/RefCycleTime; Terminal carries IpAddress/DefaultPrinter/HasBarcodeScanner) — schemas are disjoint across kinds

Precondition: A Terminal-kind Location selected in the tree
Step: Open its attribute values and review the offered attributes
Expected Result: Only attributes belonging to the Terminal definition are offered; a DieCastMachine attribute (e.g. Tonnage) cannot be set on a Terminal

Step: Verify the FRS Appendix B machines are present as Cell Locations
Expected Result: The ~230 machines are loaded as Cell-tier Locations under their Areas/Work Centers with appropriate kinds and seeded attribute values (tonnage, cycle time where available)

Precondition: Configuration Tool Eligibility screen open for an item
Step: Add an ItemLocation row (target any tier — Area, Work Center, or Cell), update it, and remove another
Expected Result: Rows are created/updated/removed with the Location picker allowing any tier; every change is logged to the config audit log

Step: Enable IsConsumptionPoint and set Min / Max / Default quantities
Expected Result: Min/Max/Default inputs appear when IsConsumptionPoint is enabled and persist on the row; they drive the runtime Allocations grid (pre-fill Default, validate Min <= entered <= Max)
